description: Defines a nonempty connected induced common-tree isomorphism independently of a solver, including partial bijections, node and edge weights, negative infinity, singleton optima, and Lean witness foundations.

related_resources.reason: Pinned arXiv v4, Section 2 and Section 3, independent score, Equation (1), Lemma 2, and the 2016 source-to-proof crosswalk.

learning_objectives: Define and test a nonempty connected induced partial-bijection witness
Compute vertex and edge weighted scores including negative and negative-infinity cases
Distinguish the paper optimum from the empty-allowed API extension
Navigate Lean Mapping, Valid, score, inducedIso and exists_maximum
